Independent replay: python3 /workspace/review_checks.py 2. The recursion weights each possible next winner by 1/(number feasible+s), and recursively obtains the marked Laplace transform without imposing the three-race mixture. For n=9 it matches both proposed branch transforms at s=1/3 and s=5/2 over 2,216 feasible states.
correctness.rationale: Every vertex that is still feasible at a successful arrival is unarrived: feasibility only decreases, and it would have been accepted had it arrived earlier. Conditioning on the previous winners and their times therefore leaves fresh independent rate-one residuals on the feasible sites. The first three feasible-set sizes are binom(n,2), 2(n−2), and n−2. At the third race the winner is independent of the wait and exactly one winner closes a triangle. On the star branch n−4 compatible sites remain, and their maximum residual determines the last successful time. The symmetry action is transitive on the labels within either outcome. The moments follow from the Bernoulli size defect; scaling the three waits by n on the triangle branch and centering the maximum of n−4 exponentials on the star branch give the stated limits. The two sizes are distinct for n≥5.
residual_risks: The finite calculation does not establish arbitrary-n or limiting laws. The frozen checker's exponential factor assertions themselves do not independently reconstruct the time mixture.
